name: Sam bo luong
summary: Sâm bổ lượng is on the 19 Jun 2019 list for Phạm Hồng Thái, with mì Quảng, bún thịt nướng, ram cuốn cải, ram bắp, ốc hút, sinh tố, and chè. The page does not say what is in the glass.
origin: Named on that Da Nang night street. A recipe was not printed.
howToEat: The 2019 page names sâm bổ lượng and does not describe a method. Check on arrival.
where: Phạm Hồng Thái. That page prints 17:00–23:00 in the bullet and says the street runs from about 17:00 until after 23:00. A later page names the street and does not restate the clock.
seoTitle: Sam bo luong — named on Pham Hong Thai
seoDescription: The 19 Jun 2019 Da Nang roundup names sâm bổ lượng on Phạm Hồng Thái and does not describe the glass. Check on arrival.
